title: Zombified Piglins exclusively drop Gold Nuggets
description: Zombified Piglins exclusively drop Gold Nuggets, useful for gold farms that use auto crafters.
body:
Zombified piglins only drop gold nuggets, a mod for minecraft java 26.2 . Useful for gold farms with auto crafters and for creators like me which are too lazy to build an item sorter to filter out the rotten flesh, gold swords, spear, etc. 


Put this in your mods folder and restart minecraft.

Enjoy.
